meta.pitch: An incentive for an accounts-receivable team that pays more for older money collected and for promises to pay that were kept.
meta.whoPays: A company, from a pool tied to what its collections team recovers
meta.signals: Amount collected by age of the invoice (current, 31-60, 61-90, over 90 days), promises to pay kept and broken - from the receivables ledger or a spreadsheet export
meta.idea: Older debt is harder, so it earns more points per unit collected. A small part of the bonus is released at the end of the quarter, which keeps the team interested in collections that stay paid.
meta.limits: Harmony does not collect debt, score credit or move invoices: it only turns what the team already recorded into points and a payout. The unit of the collected metrics is yours to choose (the template assumes 1 unit = 1,000 of your currency, and its caps are in those units: 5,000 units is 5 million), so change the caps if your currency is worth much more or less, and the amounts come from a ledger that people can edit: review the events before paying. Only the bonus is on the ledger, never the invoices or the debtors.

program.name: Collections team incentive
program.description: A proportional pool shared by points, with more points per unit the older the invoice, and a small quarter-end pocket.
